ei.title: How Television Manages Emotional Intensity Through Changes in the Degree of Closeness

fullPassage: Changes in the degree of closeness are quite important in managing emotional intensity. Take, for example, emotions induced by television. Closeness and familiarity are important in making the fictional environment more real. Accordingly, most TV shows are set in the present or in a time within the memory of the viewers. Most characters are supposed to be types with whom we are familiar. Such closeness and familiarity make it easier for us to perceive the imaginary story to be a real one. In other circumstances, such as when violence is shown on TV, the closeness variable is used to reduce emotional intensity. Television entertainment tends to place social problems involving violence in another time and place, letting us watch those fictionalized characters search for solutions to our problems in settings safely distanced from our own. When violence occurs in a contemporary setting, it is generally the product of the interaction of police and criminals ― again, it is removed from the lives of good citizenry.

questions.passage: Changes in the degree of closeness are quite (A)[important / trivial] in managing emotional intensity. Take, for example, emotions induced by television. Closeness and familiarity are important in making the fictional environment more real. Accordingly, most TV shows are set in the present or in a time within the memory of the viewers. Most characters are supposed to be types with whom we are (B)[familiar / unfamiliar]. Such closeness and familiarity make it easier for us to perceive the imaginary story to be a (C)[real / false] one. In other circumstances, such as when violence is shown on TV, the closeness variable is used to reduce emotional intensity. Television entertainment tends to place social problems involving violence in another time and place, letting us watch those fictionalized characters search for solutions to our problems in settings safely distanced from our own. When violence occurs in a contemporary setting, it is generally the product of the interaction of police and criminals ― again, it is removed from the lives of good citizenry.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.analysis:
✅ ① important - familiar - real: 친밀도의 변화는 감정 강도 관리에 '중요'하고, 등장인물은 우리가 '익숙한' 유형이어야 하며, 허구 이야기를 '실재하는' 것처럼 느끼게 한다는 원문.
❌ ② trivial - familiar - real: '사소한'은 'quite important'라는 원문과 정반대.
❌ ③ important - unfamiliar - real: '낯선' 유형은 closeness/familiarity를 강조하는 흐름과 모순.
❌ ④ important - familiar - false: '거짓인' 것으로 인식하게 만든다는 것은 fictional → real로 인식한다는 원문과 반대.
det.tip: important(중요한) ↔ trivial(사소한). familiar(익숙한) ↔ unfamiliar(낯선). real(실재하는) ↔ false(거짓의, 가짜의)

det.analysis:
✅ ② real - reduce - distanced: 허구 환경을 '실감 나게' 만들고, 폭력 장면에서는 감정 강도를 '줄이며', 우리 삶에서 '안전하게 떨어진' 배경에 둔다는 원문.

Television entertainment tends to place social problems involving violence in another time and place, letting us watch those fictionalized characters search for solutions to our problems in settings safely distanced from our own. When violence occurs in a contemporary setting, it is generally the product of the interaction of police and criminals ― again, it is removed from the lives of good citizenry.
questions.stem: 밑줄 없이 제시된 (A)와 (B)의 set의 의미로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.analysis:
✅ ③ (A) 배경이 설정된 - (B) 놓았다: (A)는 TV 쇼의 '배경이 설정된' 수동 표현, (B)는 상자를 탁자 위에 '놓다'는 동작.
❌ ① (A) 놓았다 - (B) 배경이 설정된: (A)에서 TV 쇼가 '놓였다'는 부자연스러움. (B)에서 상자에 배경 설정은 말이 안 됨.
❌ ② (A) 배경이 설정된 - (B) 배경이 설정된: (B)에서 상자의 '배경'은 맥락에 맞지 않음.
❌ ④ (A) 놓았다 - (B) 놓았다: (A)에서 TV 쇼가 현재에 '놓였다'는 부자연스럽고 수동태 맥락과 안 맞음.
det.tip: set: 1. (be set in) 배경이 ~에 설정되다 - 드라마/영화의 시공간 배경. 2. 놓다(put, place) - 물건을 어딘가에 두다.
